items.name: ConfigError
items.summary: An error that can occur when building a searcher.

items.name: BinaryDetection
items.summary: The behavior of binary detection while searching.

methods.name: convert
methods.summary: Binary detection is performed by looking for the given byte, and replacing it with the line terminator configured on the searcher. (If the searcher is configured to use `CRLF` as the line terminator, then this byte is replaced by just `LF`…

methods.name: convert_byte
methods.summary: If this binary detection uses the "convert" strategy, then this returns the byte that will be replaced by the line terminator. In any other case, this returns `None`.

methods.name: none
methods.summary: No binary detection is performed. Data reported by the searcher may contain arbitrary bytes.

methods.name: quit
methods.summary: Binary detection is performed by looking for the given byte.

methods.name: quit_byte
methods.summary: If this binary detection uses the "quit" strategy, then this returns the byte that will cause a search to quit. In any other case, this returns `None`.

items.name: Encoding
items.summary: An encoding to use when searching.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new encoding for the specified label.

items.name: Searcher
items.summary: A searcher executes searches over a haystack and writes results to a caller provided sink.

methods.name: after_context
methods.summary: Returns the number of "after" context lines to report. When context reporting is not enabled, this returns `0`.

methods.name: before_context
methods.summary: Returns the number of "before" context lines to report. When context reporting is not enabled, this returns `0`.

methods.name: binary_detection
methods.summary: Returns the type of binary detection configured on this searcher.

methods.name: invert_match
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this searcher is configured to invert its search results. That is, matching lines are lines that do **not** match the searcher's matcher.

methods.name: line_number
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this searcher is configured to count line numbers.

methods.name: line_terminator
methods.summary: Returns the line terminator used by this searcher.

methods.name: max_matches
methods.summary: Returns the maximum number of matches emitted by this searcher, if such a limit was set.

methods.name: multi_line
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this searcher is configured to perform multi line search.

methods.name: multi_line_with_matcher
methods.signature: fn multi_line_with_matcher<M: Matcher>(&self, matcher: M) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this searcher will choose a multi-line strategy given the provided matcher.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new searcher with a default configuration.

methods.name: passthru
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if the searcher has "passthru" mode enabled.

methods.name: search_file
methods.signature: fn search_file<M, S>(&mut self, matcher: M, file: &File, write_to: S) -> Result<(), S::Error> where M: Matcher, S: Sink
methods.summary: Execute a search over a file and write the results to the given sink.

methods.name: search_path
methods.signature: fn search_path<P, M, S>(&mut self, matcher: M, path: P, write_to: S) -> Result<(), S::Error> where P: AsRef<Path>, M: Matcher, S: Sink
methods.summary: Execute a search over the file with the given path and write the results to the given sink.

methods.name: search_reader
methods.signature: fn search_reader<M, R, S>(&mut self, matcher: M, read_from: R, write_to: S) -> Result<(), S::Error> where M: Matcher, R: io::Read, S: Sink
methods.summary: Execute a search over any implementation of `std::io::Read` and write the results to the given sink.

methods.name: search_slice
methods.signature: fn search_slice<M, S>(&mut self, matcher: M, slice: &[u8], write_to: S) -> Result<(), S::Error> where M: Matcher, S: Sink
methods.summary: Execute a search over the given slice and write the results to the given sink.

methods.name: set_binary_detection
methods.summary: Set the binary detection method used on this searcher.

methods.name: stop_on_nonmatch
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this searcher is configured to stop when it finds a non-matching line after a matching one.

items.name: SearcherBuilder
items.summary: A builder for configuring a searcher.

methods.name: after_context
methods.signature: fn after_context(&mut self, line_count: usize) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Whether to include a fixed number of lines after every match.

methods.name: before_context
methods.signature: fn before_context(&mut self, line_count: usize) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Whether to include a fixed number of lines before every match.

methods.name: binary_detection
methods.signature: fn binary_detection(&mut self, detection: BinaryDetection) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Set the binary detection strategy.

methods.name: bom_sniffing
methods.signature: fn bom_sniffing(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Enable automatic transcoding based on BOM sniffing.

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Build a searcher with the given matcher.

methods.name: encoding
methods.signature: fn encoding(&mut self, encoding: Option<Encoding>) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Set the encoding used to read the source data before searching.

methods.name: heap_limit
methods.signature: fn heap_limit(&mut self, bytes: Option<usize>) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Set an approximate limit on the amount of heap space used by a searcher.

methods.name: invert_match
methods.signature: fn invert_match(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Whether to invert matching, whereby lines that don't match are reported instead of reporting lines that do match.

methods.name: line_number
methods.signature: fn line_number(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Whether to count and include line numbers with matching lines.

methods.name: line_terminator
methods.signature: fn line_terminator(&mut self, line_term: LineTerminator) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Set the line terminator that is used by the searcher.

methods.name: max_matches
methods.signature: fn max_matches(&mut self, limit: Option<u64>) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Sets the maximum number of matches that should be emitted by this searcher.

methods.name: memory_map
methods.signature: fn memory_map(&mut self, strategy: MmapChoice) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Set the strategy to employ use of memory maps.

methods.name: multi_line
methods.signature: fn multi_line(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Whether to enable multi line search or not.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new searcher builder with a default configuration.

methods.name: passthru
methods.signature: fn passthru(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Whether to enable the "passthru" feature or not.

methods.name: stop_on_nonmatch
methods.signature: fn stop_on_nonmatch(&mut self, stop_on_nonmatch: bool) -> &mut SearcherBuilder
methods.summary: Stop searching a file when a non-matching line is found after a matching line.
